# VizEngine — LLM Authoring Reference

> VizEngine is a zero-dependency browser engine that turns a **markdown-superset
> text format** into themed, interactive visuals: prose, tables, images, 16
> diagram kinds, ~45 UI components, 20 visual themes, animations, and real 3D.
> This file tells an LLM exactly how to write source for it. Everything below is
> the *authoring language* — plain text you put into `panel.render(sourceText)`.

Repo: https://github.com/Malwation/visualize_engine · Package: `vizengine`

## How output is consumed

```html
<script src="dist/vizengine.js"></script>
<div id="out"></div>
<script>
  const panel = new VizEngine.Panel(document.getElementById('out'), { theme: 'sketch' });
  panel.render(SOURCE_STRING);   // SOURCE_STRING is what you author
</script>
```

So: **produce a single markdown-superset string.** It may freely mix prose,
diagram fences (```` ```kind ````), directive blocks (`:::name`), and inline
widgets (`[[...]]`).

## Global authoring rules (read first)

1. **Fences start at column 0.** A code/diagram fence (```` ``` ````) and its
   info string must not be indented.
2. **Directives are block-level.** `:::name` must be the first thing on a line.
   Inline use like `Tags: :::chips …` will NOT work — put the directive on its
   own line, or use the single-line form `:::chips a, b, c :::`.
3. **Parsers are tolerant** — invalid lines are skipped, partial/streaming input
   renders whatever is valid so far, nothing throws.
4. **Comments:** inside diagram fences, a line starting with `#` is a comment.
5. **Everything is escaped safely** (text via `textContent`); URLs are limited to
   `http(s):`, relative, and `data:image/*`.
6. **Diagram layout is on a monospace character grid** but labels render in the
   theme's font (may be proportional). Keep labels concise.

---

# 1. Diagram fences

Syntax: ```` ```<kind> [flags] ```` then lines, then ```` ``` ````.
Kinds: `graph tree sequence timeline bars pie gantt graph3d bars3d sankey
treemap flame geomap network mermaid dot`.

## graph — flowchart / directed graph

Node declaration `id: <shape>`; shape comes from the bracket type:

| syntax | shape |
|---|---|
| `id: [ label ]` | box |
| `id: ( label )` | stadium (rounded ends) |
| `id: { label }` | diamond (decision) |
| `id: [[ label ]]` | container (holds children) |

- **Nesting:** dot-path ids put a node inside a container: `sandbox: [[ Sandbox ]]`
  then `sandbox.proc: [ malware.exe ]`. Missing ancestors auto-become containers.
- **Icons:** prefix the label with `@name` (see §3): `srv: [ @server host-01 ]`.
- **Tooltip:** trailing quoted string: `mal: [ malware.exe ] "packed with UPX"`.
- **Auto-nodes:** an id used only in an edge is auto-created as a box.

Edges:

| syntax | meaning |
|---|---|
| `a -> b` | arrow |
| `a <-> b` | bidirectional (arrowheads both ends) |
| `a -- b` | plain line, no arrow |
| `a -> b : "label"` | labeled (quotes optional) |
| `a -> b : "x" [err]` | colored edge; variant ∈ `ok` `warn` `err` `accent` |

Fence flags (space-separated after `graph`): direction `TD` (default) `LR` `BT`
`RL`; `iso` (2.5D); `interactive` (drag/hover/collapse); `3d`/`three` (real 3D);
animation `anim`/`flow`/`draw`/`pulse`/`beacon`/`trace`.

```graph TD
sandbox: [[ Sandbox ]]
sandbox.exp: [ @gear explorer.exe ]
sandbox.mal: [ @skull malware.exe ] "dropped to %TEMP%"
check: { Malicious? }
c2: ( @globe C2 )
sandbox.exp -> sandbox.mal : "spawns"
sandbox.mal -> check : "score"
check -> c2 : "yes" [err]
```

## tree — hierarchy (process/registry tree)

Indentation-based (2 spaces per level). Optional trailing `[box|stadium|diamond]`
overrides shape; `@icon` prefix works.

```tree
services.exe
  svchost.exe
    conhost.exe
  explorer.exe
    malware.exe [diamond]
      cmd.exe
```

## sequence — actors & messages

Optional actor label decl `id: [ Label ]` (with `@icon`). Messages `a -> b : "msg"`.
Self-message `a -> a : "loop"`.

```sequence
c: [ @user implant ]
s: [ @server c2 ]
c -> s : "beacon"
s -> c : "task: screenshot"
c -> c : "capture"
```

## timeline — stamped events

Each line: `<stamp> <rest of line>` (stamp = first whitespace token).

```timeline
00:00 detonation
00:04 drops payload
00:41 dns query evil-c2.example
```

## bars — horizontal bar chart

`label: value` (default max 100) or `label: value / max`.

```bars
behavior: 92
stealth: 45 / 200
```

## pie — donut chart

`label: value` (percentages + legend auto-computed).

```pie
trojan: 46
stealer: 27
clean: 12
```

## gantt — schedule

`label: start duration` (abstract numeric units).

```gantt
unpack: 0 2
beacon: 5 9
exfil: 9 3
```

## graph3d — real rotating 3D graph

Same node/edge syntax as `graph`; nodes get true 3D coordinates and the scene
rotates (~7s/rev, hover to pause). `graph ... 3d` is equivalent.

```graph3d
root: [ services.exe ]
a: [ svchost.exe ]
b: [ malware.exe ]
root -> a
a -> b
```

## bars3d — extruded 3D bars

Same as `bars`.

```bars3d
behavior: 92
network: 71
```

## sankey — weighted flow diagram

`src -> dst : weight` (weight default 1); ribbon width ∝ flow.

```sankey
phish -> macro : 40
macro -> loader : 30
loader -> exfil : 25
```

## treemap — squarified sized rectangles

Indented `name: value`; a parent's value defaults to the sum of its children.

```treemap
dropper.exe
  .text: 90
  .rsrc: 120
    icon: 30
    strings: 90
```

## flame — flame/icicle graph (call stacks)

Indented `frame: value`; stacks by depth, width ∝ value.

```flame
main: 100
  unpack: 45
  execute: 55
    inject: 35
```

## geomap — geographic threat map

Nodes: `id @ City | label` (built-in city table, ~42 cities) or
`id: lat,lon | label`. Labels may start with an `@icon` (drawn at the pin).
Edges become arcs with arrowheads: `from -> to | label [variant] [style]` where
variant ∈ `ok warn err accent` and style ∈ `dashed dotted solid`.

```geomap
victim @ New York | @user victim host
relay @ Amsterdam | @server relay
c2 @ Moscow | @skull C2 primary
victim -> relay | c2 login [warn] dashed
relay -> c2 | beacon [err]
```

Known cities include: amsterdam, moscow, beijing, tokyo, london, new york,
los angeles, berlin, paris, sao paulo, sydney, mumbai, singapore, dubai, lagos,
johannesburg, toronto, chicago, seoul, istanbul, kyiv, tehran, cairo, bucharest,
hong kong, delhi, bangkok, jakarta, madrid, rome, san francisco, washington,
frankfurt, stockholm, oslo, reykjavik, nairobi. Unknown cities are skipped; use
explicit `lat,lon` otherwise.

## network — force-directed topology

Same syntax as `graph`. Nodes are placed by a deterministic force simulation
(organic layout) with straight edges.

```network
gw: [ @server gateway ]
h1: [ host-1 ]
h2: [ host-2 ]
gw -> h1
gw -> h2
h1 -> h2
h2 -> gw [err]
```

## mermaid — import a Mermaid flowchart

Paste Mermaid `flowchart`/`graph` syntax; it renders in the active theme.
Supports `A[box] A(round) A{diamond} A((circle))`, edges `-->` `---` `-.->`,
`-->|label|`, chains, `flowchart TD|LR`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[explorer.exe] --> B{Suspicious?}
  B -->|yes| C(malware.exe)
```

## dot — import a Graphviz DOT graph

Paste `digraph`/`graph { ... }`; supports `a -> b [label="x"]`,
`n [label="y" shape=diamond]`, `rankdir=LR`.

```dot
digraph { rankdir=LR; a -> b [label="open"]; b -> c; }
```

---

# 2. Graph capabilities (flags & features)

- **Icons** — `@name` in any node/actor/tree label. See §3.
- **Connections** — `->` `<->` `--`, plus variant `[ok|warn|err|accent]`.
- **Directions** — `graph TD|LR|BT|RL`.
- **Isometric** — add `iso`: `graph TD iso`. Projects to 2.5D slabs.
- **Interactive** — add `interactive`: drag nodes, hover to focus neighbors,
  click a container's `▾` toggle to collapse. (Or pass `interactive:true` to the
  Panel to apply to all graphs.)
- **Real 3D** — `graph3d` or `graph … 3d`.
- **Animation** — `anim` (flow+draw), or one of `flow` (marching edges),
  `draw` (staggered reveal), `pulse` (breathing), `beacon` (ping rings),
  `trace` (sequential edge highlight). Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Example combining flags: ```` ```graph LR iso flow ````.

---

# 3. Node icons (16)

Use as `@name` at the START of a node label. Unknown names are ignored (label
still renders). Available:

`server database file gear globe user shield bug folder lock alert terminal
chip cloud mail skull`

Example: `n: [ @skull dropper.exe ]`, `db: ( @database evidence )`.

---

# 4. Directive components — `:::name … :::`

General form:
```
:::name optional-args
inner line 1
inner line 2
:::
```
Single-line form: `:::name inline args :::`. Some use `== Label` inner sections.
Full list of names: `tabs accordion steps columns grid card divider meta stat
score gauge ring rating status heatmap legend chips dtimeline swatches banner
note quote ioc verdict mitre hexdump yara compare alert terminal kbd spinner
loader pulsedot typewriter beacon radar countdown matrix`.

## Layout

**tabs** — inner `== Label` panels; click to switch. Panels contain markdown.
```
:::tabs
== Summary
Sample is a **stealer**.
== IOCs
- 45.13.7.2:443
:::
```

**accordion** — inner `== Label` items, each collapsible.

**columns** — inner `== Label` sections become columns.

**grid** — inner `== Label` sections become a responsive card grid.

**card** — `:::card <title>` then body markdown → one titled card.

**divider** — `:::divider <label> :::` → a labeled horizontal rule.

**meta** — `term :: value` lines → a key/value card.
```
:::meta
SHA-256 :: 9f86d0…
C2 :: 45.13.7.2:443
:::
```

## Data / metrics

**stat** — KPI tiles, one per line `value | label | delta` (delta `+`/`-`
colors up/down; counts up on render).
```
:::stat
92 / 100 | Behavior | +14
3 | Processes |
:::
```

**score** — `value [/ max] [grade] [label]` → big number + grade.
`:::score` / `92 A threat` / `:::`

**gauge** — `value [/ max] [label]` → half-circle gauge (sweeps to value).

**ring** — `value [/ max] [label]` → full circular progress ring.

**rating** — `n / m [label]` → star rating.

**status** — one per line `<state> <label>`; state ∈ `ok warn err info up down
idle` → colored dot + label.

**heatmap** — rows of space/comma-separated numbers → colored cell grid.

**legend** — one per line `<color> <label>`; color ∈ `ok warn err accent muted
ink` or a `#hex`.

**chips** — comma list; prefix `!`→danger, `+`→ok, `~`→warn, none→neutral.
`:::chips !critical, +verified, ~evasion, stealer :::`

**dtimeline** — one per line `stamp | text` → vertical event timeline.

**swatches** — comma list `#hex name` → color palette chips.

## Presentation

**banner** — `:::banner Title | subtitle :::` → hero banner.

**note** — `:::note <pin>` + body → sticky note.

**quote** — `text — author` → pull quote with citation.

## Malware-analysis

**ioc** — one per line `<type> <value> [| note]` → indicator rows with copy
buttons. Type is free text (e.g. `sha256`, `ip`, `domain`, `mutex`).
```
:::ioc
sha256  9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015 | dropper
ip  45.13.7.2:443 | c2
:::
```

**verdict** — `<level> <rest>`; level ∈ `malicious suspicious clean benign
unknown` → colored verdict banner. `:::verdict` / `malicious score 92/100` / `:::`

**mitre** — comma/newline list `Txxxx[.yyy] Name` → ATT&CK technique chips.
`:::mitre T1055 Process Injection, T1071 C2 :::`

**hexdump** — inner text is encoded to a `offset | hex | ascii` dump.

**yara** — inner YARA rule with keyword highlighting.

**compare** — two inner `== Label` sections → before/after side-by-side.

**alert** — `:::alert <kind> <message> :::`; kind ∈ `note tip warn danger
success` → full-width banner.

## Widgets (general + animated)

**terminal** — `:::terminal <title>` + lines; lines starting `$ ` or `# ` are
prompts. Fake terminal window.

**kbd** — keys separated by `+` or spaces → keycaps.
`Press :::kbd Ctrl + Shift + P :::` — note: for inline sentences, keep it a
single-line directive on its own line, or the surrounding text won't render it.

Animated (motion is CSS/SMIL, respects reduced-motion): **spinner** (label),
**loader** (label), **pulsedot** (label), **typewriter** (text), **beacon**
(label), **radar** (no args), **countdown** (`:::countdown 7s` + label line),
**matrix** (no args).

---

# 5. Inline widgets (inside prose)

Standard markdown inline works: `**bold**`, `*italic*`, `` `code` ``,
`[link](url)`, `![alt](img-or-gif)`.

Plus VizEngine `[[…]]` widgets (use anywhere in a paragraph):

| syntax | renders |
|---|---|
| `[[text]]` | neutral badge chip |
| `[[!text]]` | danger badge |
| `[[+text]]` | ok/success badge |
| `[[~text]]` | warning badge |
| `[[progress 72]]` | progress bar (0–100) |
| `[[progress 3/5]]` | progress bar (n of m) |
| `[[sev 4/5]]` | severity dots (ramps ok→warn→err) |
| `[[spark 3,7,2,9,5]]` | inline sparkline mini-chart |
| `[[metric 1.2M requests]]` | big number + label |
| `[[avatar Kagan Isildak]]` | initials avatar + name |

Example: `Family [[!redline]], analysis [[progress 72]], threat [[sev 4/5]],
trend [[spark 3,7,4,9,6]].`

---

# 6. Rich document blocks

**Callouts** — a blockquote whose first line is `[!kind] Title`; kind ∈
`note tip warn warning danger success`.
```
> [!danger] Verdict: malicious
> Behavior score 92/100.
```

**Definition list (block)** — consecutive `term :: value` lines (not inside a
table).
```
SHA-256 :: 9f86d0…
C2 :: 45.13.7.2:443
```

**Collapsible** — `+++ Summary` … `+++`.
```
+++ Raw strings
GetProcAddress
VirtualAlloc
+++
```

**HTML previewer** — a *closed* ```` ```html ```` fence renders as
preview/code tabs backed by a sandboxed iframe (`sandbox="allow-scripts"`).

**filetree** — ```` ```filetree ```` fence, indented text → collapsible file/
registry tree.

**diff** — ```` ```diff ```` fence; lines starting `+`/`-`/space → added/removed/
context coloring.

**Task lists** — `- [x] done` / `- [ ] todo`.

**Tables** — GFM pipe tables with `:--` / `--:` alignment.

**Other markdown** — headings `#`–`####`, ordered/unordered lists (nested),
blockquotes, `---` horizontal rule, fenced code with language badge + copy button.

---

# 7. Themes (20)

Each theme is a distinct design language — different fonts, canvas textures,
**node shapes**, strokes, glow, shadows. Set via the Panel option `theme` or
`panel.setTheme(name)`. Names:

`sketch` (default) · `sketch-dark` · `blueprint` · `neon` · `notebook` · `glass`
· `terminal` · `carbon` · `8bit` · `ink` · `crt-amber` · `synthwave` ·
`midnight` · `solarized` · `dracula` · `nord` · `mono-print` · `hologram` ·
`kraft` · `wireframe`

Themes do not change the *source* you write — only how it looks. Author once,
render in any theme.

---

# 8. JavaScript API

```js
const panel = new VizEngine.Panel(el, {
  theme: 'sketch',          // any of VizEngine.themes
  interactive: false,       // enable drag/focus/collapse on all graphs
  onNodeClick: (node) => {}, // node = {id, label, shape, title}
  onNodeHover: (nodeOrNull) => {},
});
panel.render(source);        // full render (idempotent)
panel.stream(chunk);         // append + tolerant re-render (for streamed LLM output)
panel.setTheme('neon');      // live theme switch
panel.exportSVG(0);          // nth diagram → self-contained SVG string
panel.exportPNG(0);          // nth diagram → Promise<Blob>
panel.toAscii(0);            // nth graph/tree → copy-pasteable ASCII (null for 3d/iso)
panel.clear();
panel.destroy();

// module-level
VizEngine.render(el, source, opts); // one-shot → Panel
VizEngine.fromMermaid(text);        // Mermaid → graph model
VizEngine.fromDot(text);            // DOT → graph model
VizEngine.renderAscii(layout);      // layout → ASCII string
VizEngine.themes;                   // string[] of 20 theme names
VizEngine.version;
```

**Web component** — zero JS needed on the page:
```html
<viz-engine theme="neon" interactive>
```graph LR
a: [ loader ]
b: [ payload ]
a -> b : "unpack"
```
</viz-engine>
```
It auto-registers when `dist/vizengine.js` loads, dedents its content, and
re-renders when the `theme` attribute changes. Set `.source = "…"` in JS to
update programmatically.

**Streaming** — for live/LLM output, call `panel.stream(chunk)` repeatedly; the
parser tolerates unterminated fences and renders completed parts as they arrive.

---

# 9. Quick authoring recipes

**A malware sandbox report** (mix everything):
```
# Dynamic Analysis — sample.exe

:::verdict
malicious score 92/100 · family RedLine
:::

:::stat
92 / 100 | Behavior | +14
3 | Processes |
1 | C2 endpoint | -2
:::

## Execution flow

```graph TD
s: [[ Sandbox ]]
s.exp: [ @gear explorer.exe ]
s.mal: [ @skull malware.exe ]
c2: ( @globe C2 )
s.exp -> s.mal : "spawns"
s.mal -> c2 : "beacon" [err]
```

## Indicators

:::ioc
sha256  9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015 | dropper
ip  45.13.7.2:443 | c2
:::

:::mitre
T1055 Process Injection, T1071 C2, T1547.001 Registry Run Keys
:::

> [!warn] Note
> Sleeps ~40s before beaconing.
```

**Do / Don't**
- DO put each diagram fence and directive on its own lines, unindented.
- DO keep node labels short; use `@icons` for meaning.
- DON'T indent fences or embed `:::name` mid-sentence (use single-line form).
- DON'T rely on a specific theme in the source — themes are chosen at render.
- 3D and isometric diagrams can't be ASCII-exported (`toAscii` returns null).
